dataset_name: Shahriar University Phishing & Enron Legitimate Corpus
primary_paper: Shahriar, S., Mukherjee, A., & Gnawali, O. (2022). Improving Phishing Detection Via Psychological Trait Scoring. IADIS MCCSIS 2022.
description: Curated benchmark combining genuine phishing emails collected from university security reports and legitimate enterprise emails from the Enron corpus. Strictly separates phishing from legitimate (NOT generic spam/commercial marketing).
